name: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Seismic Sensor Network SSN-3
product_name: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Seismic Sensor Network SSN-3
description: A deployable network of ground-mounted seismic sensors that detect and classify movement on and below the surface within a monitored area. Each sensor spike is driven into the ground and detects vibrations from footsteps, vehicles, tunneling activity, and structural settling. The network's AI classifies detected vibrations — distinguishing between a walking person, a running person, a vehicle, and mechanical digging — and provides the count, direction, and speed of detected movement. The system can detect a single person walking at up to 100 meters and a vehicle at up to 500 meters through ground vibration alone.

specifications.info: 500m vehicle per sensor; run; vehicle; dig; structural; neural interface compatible; 10 seconds per sensor; sand; concrete; and rock

story_hooks: An SSN-3 network deployed around a secure facility detected tunneling activity 5 meters underground — someone is digging toward the facility from a building 200 meters away.

An SSN-3 network in Tier 1 detected a regular pattern of heavy vehicle movement through an area with no road access — the vehicles are using an underground tunnel system that surface observers never knew existed.

physical_description.visual_profile: A modular seismic sensor network comprising individual ground-spike sensors and a handheld controller unit. Each sensor resembles a hardened nail or surveying spike with an integrated vibration-detection head, while the controller is a rugged palm-sized device with a small holographic display node.
physical_description.dimensions: Individual sensors: 15cm length, 1.2cm diameter spike. Controller unit: 12cm × 8cm × 4cm
physical_description.weight_description: Each sensor weighs 200g, easily pocket-carried in clusters. Controller handheld, lightweight carrying strap optional for extended fieldwork.
physical_description.primary_material: Sensor spikes: hardened tungsten-steel alloy with vibration-responsive piezoelectric crystal core. Controller: aerospace-grade polymer frame with rubberized impact zones.
physical_description.finish: Sensor spikes: dull gunmetal with etched calibration marks and depth graduations. Controller: brushed charcoal finish with textured grip panels.
physical_description.color_scheme: Matte dark gray spikes with luminous teal accent rings marking the sensor head. Controller body charcoal black with cyan status indicators and Zheng-Dao brand stripe.
physical_description.interface_elements: Controller features micro-holographic readout (2cm projection), four tactile pressure buttons (deploy/retrieve/classify/sync), neural-link induction plate, and weathered tactile feedback haptic strips. USB-C charging port on side.
distinctive_features: Piezoelectric sensor head glows faintly cyan when active during vibration detection
Depth-marking rings laser-etched every 2cm down the spike shaft
Holographic AR readout displays concentric threat-rings showing detected movement vectors
Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries ideogram stamped on controller base
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: ZHENG-DAO HEAVY INDUSTRIES logo on controller grip; SSN-3 model number etched beneath. Regulatory compliance stamps: GLMZ Tier 2 certified, neural-interface safe rating.
physical_description.condition_typical: Sensors often show soil caking and mineral deposits after deployment. Controller weathered from field use, with minor scuffs on polymer edges. Teal accent markers dulled from sunlight exposure but functional.
